physical_initialization_requirements.interpretation: tINIT1 is a reset-low requirement after valid supplies; tINIT2 constrains CKE low before reset rises. tINIT3 starts at RESET_n rising, tINIT4 requires stable clocks before CKE rises, and tINIT5 starts at CKE rising. A 200 us wait after writing MemResetL=2 does not satisfy those later intervals or prove CKE pin state.
physical_initialization_requirements.boot_clock: The cited ISSI device guarantees boot operation with tCKb >=18 ns; operation faster than that requires system-specific validity. The current 1800 MHz analog setup is not by itself permission to issue cold device commands at that rate.
physical_initialization_requirements.separation: PHY impedance calibration and DRAM MPC ZQ calibration are different operations. Neither a PHY register readback nor a timer expiry proves the corresponding analog or device operation completed.

checked_time_conversion_design.formula: ticks = ceil(ns * tick_hz / (1000000000 * quantum_cycles)); ticks = max(ticks, minimum_ticks)
checked_time_conversion_design.integer_method: Reject zero frequency/quantum and invalid width. Check multiplication against UINT64_MAX before multiplying. Compute numerator/denominator + (numerator%denominator != 0), avoiding an overflowing numerator+denominator-1. Reject a result exceeding the field width instead of truncating.
checked_time_conversion_design.inputs: Keep physical CK frequency, controller clock frequency, selected hardware counter frequency and counter quantum as distinct fields. Do not silently infer the counter frequency from a PHY encoding integer.
checked_time_conversion_design.scope_limit: This is the proposed arithmetic contract, not new runtime code or confirmation that every controller counter uses the same clock domain.

INITTMG0.programming_mode: The independent TRM marks the two timing fields Static and skip_dram_init Quasi-dynamic group 2. Its default Static definition requires controller reset; SWCTLSTATIC offers an explicit outside-reset exception, described separately below. STAT=INIT alone is not proof of either permitted condition.
INITTMG0.t736_host_fact: At pstate0, the host computes the two waits with auto_cal_timing at CK/4, shifts the resulting count by 10, adds 1, and merges with mask 0x03ff1fff. At CK1800 MHz that calculation uses 450 MHz.
INITTMG0.rounding_difference: The host expression floor(ceil(ns*f/1e9)/1024)+1 adds an extra quantum at exact boundaries. Independent ceil(ns*f/(1e9*1024)) satisfies the same minimum without treating the host arithmetic as normative; the example above coincides.
INITTMG0.unit_qualification: RK3576 field text says DRAM clock cycles and references Note 1 from Notes on Timing Registers, but that note was not present in the inspected chapter introduction. T736 host CK/4 is therefore explicit target evidence, not independently proven counter clock. At full CK1800 MHz the physical-time formula would instead produce pre3516/post4. Resolve by target specification or a measured externally observable transition before relying on hardware delays.
INITTMG0.skip_policy: Do not set skip=1 merely to reach normal mode. Skipping assumes software has actually performed all device initialization. Do not set skip=3 for a cold device. Historical train_mode behavior is not a source initialization policy.

INITTMG1.public_semantic: Duration of DRAM reset assertion during the controller initialization sequence; at least one quantum with Synopsys PHY. Lower16 and upper6 are reserved in the independent TRM.
INITTMG1.qualification: The inspected T736 timing helper did not establish a write to this register. Do not assume the reset default provides tINIT1. Determine whether software PHY reset or the controller owns each edge and wait; the external reset sequence and hardware counter must not be double-counted or omitted. The clock-domain qualification of INITTMG0 also applies here.
INITTMG1.programming_mode: Static; integrate before reset release or establish the target SWCTLSTATIC unlock route.

static_update_candidate.name: SWCTLSTATIC
static_update_candidate.field: sw_static_unlock bit0; remaining31 bits reserved in independent TRM
static_update_candidate.source_location: RK3576 TRM printed672; extracted text around5569
static_update_candidate.public_semantic: Setting bit0 permits static register programming outside reset; clear it after programming.
static_update_candidate.target_status: Not yet read or written on T736. Name/address compatibility is not proof that the target permits the same transaction. A fixed read can establish accessibility/reset value before an independently reviewed narrow write experiment.
static_update_candidate.integration: Retain both-controller INIT/hold/ports-off preconditions and bounded transaction/readback evidence. Opening SWCTL/SWSTAT for quasi-dynamic fields is not automatically the same as this static unlock. Do not assert that INIT mode alone unlocks Static registers.

MR_profile_and_static_packing.design: Use one typed profile with explicit FSP, latency set, DBI, pre/postamble, ODT and VREF selections. Generate CTL INITMR images, PHY expectations and actual MRW operands from that same profile. Validate code ranges and reject unsupported combinations before any MMIO mutation.
MR_profile_and_static_packing.pair_formula: pair(hi,lo) = ((uint32_t)hi << 16) | lo, after both operands are verified 8-bit mode-register values; preserve unrelated fields according to a verified target mask.

historical_profile_decode.MR1_0xfc: BL16; write preamble2CK; toggling read preamble; nWR40; read postamble1.5CK.
historical_profile_decode.MR2_0x3f: DBI-off RL36, WL18 setA, write leveling disabled.
historical_profile_decode.MR3_0x33: Read/write DBI off; pull-down RZQ/6; write-postamble bit1 set; pull-up calibration VDDQ/3; PPR-protection bit clear.
historical_profile_decode.MR11_0x04: DQ ODT RZQ/4; CA ODT disabled.
historical_profile_decode.MR12_0x72: CA VREF range1/code50; a selected setting, not proof of source training.
historical_profile_decode.MR13_0x08: FSP-OP0/FSP-WR0; VRCG bit3 set for fast VREF response. Data mask disable is bit5 and is clear. CBT/RPT/VRO clear.
historical_profile_decode.MR14_0x1d: DQ VREF range0/code29; historical selected setting may be training-derived.
historical_profile_decode.MR22_0x24: SoC ODT RZQ/4; ODTD-CA bit5 set; ODTE-CK bit3 and ODTE-CS bit4 clear. Actual termination also depends on MR11 and ODT_CA wiring.

MR_profile_and_static_packing.correction: An earlier conversational shorthand incorrectly associated MR13 bit3 with DM disable. The verified mapping is bit3=VRCG, bit5=DMD; MR13=0x08 leaves data masking enabled.
MR_profile_and_static_packing.latency_encoding: For the existing profile, JEDEC nWR40 maps to MR1[6:4]=7; DBI-off RL36 maps to MR2[2:0]=7; setA WL18 maps to MR2[5:3]=7. These encodings do not themselves establish frequency compatibility for the fitted part.
MR_profile_and_static_packing.frequency_compatibility: The current source timing subset uses CK1800/RL36/WL18/nWR40. Micron Table30 places that combination in 1866..2133 MHz and explicitly restricts operation below its lower frequency; RL32/WL16/nWR34 is its 1600..1866 MHz row. This is an unresolved fitted-device qualification, not a universal statement that higher latency at lower frequency is illegal. Do not change the accepted subset from this unrelated device table alone.
MR_profile_and_static_packing.historical_inputs: demo_aiot-bak raw MR1=0x8c/MR2=0 are not the final speed-derived MR values. SDK MR14 selection can use a trained byte at parameter offset200 rather than its static input, depending on tpr10 bit29. Do not label a replayed final byte as source-trained.
MR_profile_and_static_packing.automatic_init_coverage: The independent TRM explicitly says INITMR2's MR11/MR12 and INITMR3's MR22/MR14 values are for HWFFC, not automatic initialization. INITMR0/1 describe MR1/MR2/MR3/MR13 initialization. Thus all four configuration words plus automatic init still do not demonstrate that the four electrical MR values were sent; the explicit software command path must cover required device state.
MR_profile_and_static_packing.command_separation: INITMR writes configure controller images; they are not evidence that MRW reached a DRAM device. The independent MRCTRL0.sw_init_int interface is being audited separately. Before commands, establish valid clock/CKE/reset sequencing, both-channel intervention policy and bounded completion evidence. MRR receive validity requires its own capture path.
